text:
customer-success-julie: Heads up — Zenith is seeing a spike in client retries and 5xxs after today's routing config push. About ~30% of embedding requests are timing out. Customer is P1, wants an ETA on mitigation. https://zendesk/12345 :frowning:
eng-manager-ada: @lia can you take point? cc @omar @carmen. We need owner, short-term mitigation, and a commitment window. :eyes:
lia: Taking it. Quick clarifying q — this is a Dedicated pool (zen-prod-1) right? Any sample errors or logs?
customer-success-julie: Yes dedicated, zone us-west-2, pool zen-prod-1. Error excerpt: "kv cache miss + request queue overflow for model redwood-1-large". Attached sample logs in the ticket.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-329 — https://incidents/INC-2024-329 (severity P1).
lia: Initial triage: routing fallback is shunting traffic to a larger model variant causing queueing and high KV miss amplification. Quick mitigation plan: 1) disable automatic variant fallback for zen-prod-1 2) temporarily increase pool burst capacity + monitor. CLI to run now:
```bash
ctl pool update zen-prod-1 --fallback-enabled=false
ctl pool scale zen-prod-1 --burst 2
```
omar: The routing change needs a tiny change in route-service (PR #5421) — I can author the PR and do the rollout, but need a review. Estimate ~45m - 1h for PR + rollout.
carmen: I can flip the burst to +2x from the ops panel for 30m immediately, but any longer needs SRE signoff (capacity cost + risk).
sre_mike: Confirmed p99 latency jumped from ~120ms to ~1.5s. I'm OK with a 30m burst increase as a stopgap. If we disable fallback, we should watch cache-miss rate; set alert if >20% for 5m.
lia: I'll apply the CLI workaround now for immediate relief and start the PR. Ping @omar for review. Lia -> applying changes and will report in 15m. :mechanical_arm:
customer-success-julie: Notifying the customer with "mitigation in progress, ETA ~2h for engineering fix". They asked for owner name and timeline.
eng-manager-ada: Good. Please add owner labels to the incident and set a follow-up checkpoint in 2 hours. Can we target a hotfix release by EOD? If that risks rollout quality, schedule the patch tomorrow morning and provide the customer the planned window.
lia: Hotfix plan: PR -> code review -> canary rollout -> full rollout. Target hotfix in ~2h if review is fast, otherwise patch tomorrow AM. If PR stalls, maintain burst and monitor. Hotfix will include a routing safeguard to prevent variant bounce.
omar: @eng-sre please review PR 5421 when available. Link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/route-service/pulls/5421
oncall-bot: Pager rule: alert if error_rate > 5% for 10m.
sre_mike: I'll review PR in ~10m and provide signoff for the rollout.
lia: Update: CLI changes applied. Error rate dropped to 4%, p99 down to ~400ms. Monitoring the next 30m and will post metrics. :thumbsup:
customer-success-julie: Customer acknowledged the mitigation and accepts the 2h ETA for fix. They request a postmortem timeline. :white_check_mark:
eng-manager-ada: Postmortem draft due by EOD tomorrow. Thanks team — keep updates on the incident thread and ping me for any blocker.
lia: Will do. I'll post the PR link and canary metrics here once available.
omer: (typo) — ignoring
